The deferred revenues related to Paxlovid and Comirnaty totaled $ 1.4 billion as of June 28, 2026, with $ 521 million and $ 855 million recorded in current liabilities and noncurrent liabilities, respectively. The decrease in Paxlovid and Comirnaty deferred revenues during the first six months of 2026 was primarily driven by amounts recognized in Product revenues as we delivered the products to our customers.
